criteria.requirement: Repair _CliArg.dest so a validation_alias only strips the CLI/env prefix when alias validation is actually enabled. With cli_prefix and validate_by_alias=False, --app.apple must update apple even when Field(alias=...) or validation_alias exists. Preserve normal alias validation, plain fields, no-prefix behavior, nested prefix and kebab-case. Disabled aliases remain rejected; do not enable alias validation or accept both names to mask loss.
